name: Interactive Pool
description: Augmented-reality pool table: projects interactive visuals onto a billiard table using camera-detected balls, hands, and cue. Includes always-on overlays (balls, cue, hands), a gesture-driven menu, and several launchable experiences (rabbits game, affine functions, triangle geometry, univers, ambient display, and a live ball-stream relay).
author: GOSAI

markers.title: Step 1 - ArUco Markers
markers.help: Aim the camera so all 9 markers are visible. Use arrow keys to pan and the scroll wheel to zoom the pattern to fit the pool table. Press Space or Next when ready.

surface-corners.title: Step 2 - Pool Corners
surface-corners.help: Click the pool table corners in order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Drag a corner to adjust it. Press r to reset.

compute.title: Step 3 - Compute Homography
compute.help: Computing the camera/projector homography for the pool table surface.

preview.title: Step 4 - Preview
preview.help: Check that the projected preview lands on the pool table. Press Space or Done to save the calibration.

projectorMessages.surfaceCorners: pick pool table corners on the control window

experiences.name: Interactive Pool
experiences.description: Main composited experience. Always shows the ball, cue, and hand overlays and listens for the two-hand menu gesture to launch sub-layers.

groups.label: Setup text
groups.description: Text projected on the table while setting it up.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: "INTERACTIVE POOL PROJECT" along the bottom edge.

fields.label: Render frame rate
fields.description: How many frames per second the projection draws, in the top-left corner.

fields.label: Ball detection rate
fields.description: How many camera frames per second the ball driver processes, along the bottom edge.

groups.label: Live relay
groups.description: Streams ball positions, normalised to 0..1, to an external WebSocket server.

fields.label: Relay URL
fields.description: WebSocket URL such as wss://example.com/realtimepool/ws. Leave empty to turn the relay off. A ws:// URL, e.g. a relay on the local network, also needs its origin under network.connect in gosai.app.json; see the app README.
